source: Kimi K2.7 Code PP13 qualification telemetry on 2026-06-13 plus first-three PP8 Qwen/Gemma measured per-layer memory from profiles/production/first3_resident_memory_budget.json.

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Kimi2.7 triad admission uses the safe resident service cap of max_num_seqs=128 with a 65536-token service gate after the 2026-06-15 pulled-main launch showed the 256/131072 envelope can push multiple 13-node stages into the high-90% system-RAM band during model init/profiling. Pulled-main DSAPI probes still record 128x512x128 reaching 143.5 tok/s; the 256-way measurements remain stretch data until the 14-node memory margin is available. Qwen uses its live max_num_seqs=32 service cap and Gemma stays at batch 16 until a separate relaunch gate.

throughput_utility_metric.goal: Rank resident 3x pipeline candidates by useful generated throughput while preserving minimum input/output budgets and avoiding oversized GPU KV residency.
throughput_utility_metric.formula: score = assumed_decode_tok_s * lane_weight * accuracy_weight * batch_factor * input_budget_factor * output_budget_factor * kv_efficiency

factor_definitions.kv_resident_input_batches: kv_capacity_tokens / (batch_size * input_budget_tokens), or a measured equivalent
factor_definitions.kv_efficiency: 0 below min_kv_resident_input_batches, 1 from min through preferred, preferred/actual above preferred

service_candidates.measurement_status: measured on kimi27-92-batch32-4096-secondpass-20260613T1540Z: 74/92 accuracy, 124689 completion tokens, 7693.375s, 16.207321 aggregate completion tok/s; COMPSEC 17/17; local prefix-cache replay hit 25568 prompt tokens, external KV transfer 0
requires pulled-main PP13 DSAPI batch benchmark

2026-06-14 pulled-main triad launch refused Gemma at 0.20 because spark4 had 21.17 GiB free while vLLM required 23.93 GiB; cap lowered to 0.16 for the first clean triad launch gate, then to 0.15 with a 5 GiB fixed KV cap after 2026-06-15 telemetry showed resident triad nodes at the edge of system RAM. After the 2026-06-15 all-node restart audit still showed several stages near the 90% system-RAM line, the triad KV caps were backed off by 3%.

throughput_utility_metric.promotion_rule: Promote the highest-scoring candidate whose hard constraints pass; if Kimi cannot fit with Qwen and Gemma below the GPU cap and memory floor, run Kimi as a dedicated smart lane and keep Qwen/Gemma as the high-throughput resident pair.

kimi_batch128_fit_estimate.basis: Live Kimi2.7 PP13 service backs off to a 6 GiB fixed GPU KV cap and 128-sequence launch envelope after 2026-06-15 pulled-main telemetry showed the 256/131072 envelope could push several resident triad nodes into the high-90% system-RAM band. Earlier DSAPI Kimi128 short-context probes used under 3% of the previous 8 GiB cap, so the immediate risk is launch/profiling and resident headroom rather than steady-state short-context KV.
kimi_batch128_fit_estimate.notes: This is an order-of-magnitude fit check, not a substitute for a pulled-main DSAPI benchmark. The 128-way resident default leaves about 1.4x rough fixed-KV capacity at full 8192-token inputs and much more margin for short-context batches; 256-way Kimi admission stays a stretch target for a later memory-margin gate.

projection.notes: Projection subtracts Qwen and Gemma model-layer estimates plus 2 GiB/node local CPU LMCache allowance from live Kimi-only MemAvailable. It does not count GPU-power margin; enforce power first through batch limits and service concurrency until a hardware power cap is proven.

power_policy.hardware_power_limit_status: No reliable per-Spark 150W NVML/powercap limit was exposed by nvidia-smi or /sys/class/powercap during the 2026-06-11 probe.
power_policy.initial_control: Use DSAPI service batch limits, token budgets, one-running-batch-per-compute-domain admission, and conservative refill watermarks until a hardware power cap is proven. Qwen batch 32 and Kimi dispatch batch 128 match the safe resident launch caps; Gemma stays at batch 16 until a separate relaunch gate.

promotion_gates: Kimi2.7 COMPSEC17 and 92-question runs stay within the accepted quality range for the smart lane.
Kimi2.7, Qwen27 PP13, and Gemma4 PP13 services are all launched from pulled main checkouts and pass DSAPI smoke through the triad topology.
LMCache canaries prove cache load/store does not change answers for each resident service.
Run a metric-scored batch sweep starting at Kimi/Qwen/Gemma 128/32/16; only raise Kimi or Gemma after the pulled-main launch passes the memory floor, readiness, accuracy, and cache gates.
